# VertexRed <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [Blitz3D](Blitz3D) · [Surfaces](Blitz3D-Surfaces)

</div>


```blitzbasic
VertexRed:Float32 surface:Int32, index:Int32
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `surface` | In | Int32 | required | Surface handle. |
| `index` | In | Int32 | required | Index of the vertex, from 0. |

**Returns:** The red part of the vertex color, a whole number from 0 to 255.

_Not documented yet._
